name: Airioch Feabhruadh
text: Airioch Feabhruadh is a variant spelling of the name Erech Febria. MacKillop lists Airioch Feabhruadh as an alternate form of that headword. Both forms point to the same early figure in the sources. Readers should consult the Erech Febria entry for the full account.
